# Changelog

## v1.0

- Initial release for the Flipper Apps Catalog.
- Receive Wireless M-Bus telegrams at 868.95 MHz in T and C modes.
- Validate frame length and CRC, browse packet history, and inspect packet details.
- Decode supported Qundis QWater v2 and Apator telegrams and standard DIF/VIF records.
- Support Mode 5 AES-128 decryption with user-supplied keys.
- Configure packet quality and RSSI filters and optional dated CSV logging.
